payload.rebuttal: fixed: `_rt_pool_cut_entry` now builds its `error` by calling the real `review._review_pool_cut(ReviewPool(remaining=0.10, floor=1.00), witness)` instead of hand-typing the wording. That entry feeds the RT-I/RT-L refusal cases, so they now exercise `_pool_cut_witness` against the live function's own output. I verified the fix by changing review.py's "never started" to "did not run": the test now fails, where before it stayed green.
